description: Checks a design handoff list for gaps. Pass `spec` as JSON (an array of {name, states, sizes, tokens, behaviours, notes, redlines}) or as lines such as `Button | states: default, hover | sizes: 40px | tokens: color.brand.500 | behaviour: truncates`. The component type is inferred from the name (button, input, checkbox, toggle, select, link, tab, modal, tooltip, list or table, card, avatar, navigation) and compared with the states usually needed for that type, plus sizes (including WCAG 2.5.8 target size), token categories (colour, spacing, type, radius), and behaviours (keyboard, long text, resize, empty, loading, error, focus, focus trap, motion timing). Lists redlines worth requesting. The expected sets are conventions. It sees only what you paste, not the design file.

spec.description: JSON array of components, or one component per line separated by pipes.

name: check_handoff_spec
title: Handoff spec check
